import json, re, sys

def split_row(s):
    out, i, n = [], 0, len(s)
    while True:
        if i < n and s[i] == '"':
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and s[j] != '"':
                j += 2 if s[j] == "\\" else 1
            token = s[i:j + 1]
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(token))
            except ValueError:
                out.append(token[1:-1])
            i = j + 1
        else:
            j = s.find(",", i)
            if j < 0:
                j = n
            out.append(s[i:j])
            i = j
        if i >= n:
            return out
        i += 1

text = sys.stdin.read()
header = None
rows = []
for line in text.split("\n"):
    if header is None:
        m = re.match(r"^tasks\[[0-9]+\]\{([^}]*)\}:$", line)
        if m:
            header = m.group(1).split(",")
        continue
    if line.startswith("  "):
        rows.append(split_row(line[2:]))
    else:
        break
if header is None:
    if re.search(r"^count: 0$", text, re.M):
        sys.exit(0)
    sys.stderr.write("fm-awaiting-captain: backlog list output was not recognised\n")
    sys.exit(4)
for values in rows:
    row = dict(zip(header, values))
    if row.get("hold_kind") == "captain" and row.get("state") != "done":
        print(row.get("id", ""))
